response.justification: The candidate is a strong and versatile senior engineer with a broad web/backend/full-stack background, but the role requires native Japanese proficiency, deep Linux kernel source modification experience, and embedded security-focused networking expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP), none of which appear in the resume. There is no evidence of Japanese language skills, embedded/firmware work, or network security domain experience, making this a poor fit despite solid general engineering credentials.
strengths: Extensive, versatile senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Some low-level systems and C/C++ experience (National Instruments, audio server project)
Strong open-source, testing, and technical leadership/teaching background
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, a hard requirement for this role
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No experience with embedded networking, switch security features (MACsec, 802.1X), or related security technologies
